Name: Phineas
Dialog: Is it here yet?

Name: Mail Lady
Dialog: Sorry, boys. Not today.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Aw, rats.

Name: Mail Lady
Dialog: Oh, wait, boys. (Phineas and Ferb quickly return, excited) I almost forgot, your mom's Penny Shopper.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hey! When are you two gonna move that stupid box out of the doorway?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Box? When did that come? (He runs to open the box)

Name: Candace
Dialog: The delivery guy brought it while you two were camping out in the mailbox.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, man. I can't believe it's here! (He takes out a smaller box out of the bigger box) Finally, the world-famous x-ray vision glasses! This is gonna be great! (He rips open the box and puts on the glasses, expecting it to reveal his bones, but instead sees swirls and his hand's outline) Whoa! We got totally ripped-off! Ferb, let me see that comic again. (Ferb hands over the comic and Phineas rereads the ad) Oh, for crying out loud! "Amazing illusion"? "Fool your friends"? "Does not actually provide x-ray vision". Oh, man, this is a rip-off! It's just like that body building course we got last summer.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: And I was so looking forward to looking through things.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb, that's it! I know what we're gonna today!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, my gosh! Aren't you the cutest thing ever? (Her eyes turn into hearts) Aw, you're so adorable! I could just eat you up. Not literally, but you know what I mean.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, where's Perry?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Agent P, Doofenshmirtz is up to his usual shenanigans, but we have a more serious problem. There's a rogue agent on the loose, and he's in your area. Carl is working with our field agents...to create a composite sketch.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Finished, sir!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Carl? You said you could draw! (He crumbles the paper and sends Carl out of the room) (to Perry) I'm sorry, Agent P. In the meanwhile, he may try to find one of your secret passages and infiltrate your lair where he could hack into our mainframe. So, be on the lookout for any suspicious characters.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Look, Ferb, there's Perry!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Maybe that's where he disappears to all the time. Well, if he got himself up there, he can get himself down. Anyway, we've got the frames and the polycarbonate lens solution. Now what we need is something that really improves eyesight. (Snaps his fingers) Hey, I know!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, Ferb, you're way ahead of me!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Agent P, we hired a professional artist and got much better results. We've identified the rogue agent as Dennis. (He flips through various disguises of a mean-looking bunny.) He's a mercenary for hire and a master of disguise. (The last picture shows the same rabbit that Candace found.) You need to stop him at all costs.

Name: Candace
Dialog: First, I'm going to name you Mr. Cutie-Patootie. Then we'll give you a complete makeover, and teach you some cool tricks! You stay put while I find you a new stylish outfit. Let's see what we've got here. (While Dennis, now standing upright, uses blueprints to search for an entrance to Perry's lair) What am I doing with a scepter? Huh. Next! Leopard headbands are so last year. Ooh, here's some of my doll clothes! Eh, let's skip the tiara. What is this? Leg warmers? Who wears leg warmers? I definitely don't. (Laughs)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mr. Cutie-Patootie, I finally found— (Notices Perry, then nudges him out from her room with her foot) Get away from him! I don't want your blandness to rub off. (Picks up Dennis, then slams the door) Aw, poor Mr. Cutie-Patootie. Don't mind him. Once I'm done making you over, you're going to be the new alpha pet!

Name: Dennis
Dialog: (Coughs)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Gasps) I know! Matching shoes!

Name: Candace
Dialog: I found it! These shoes should complete the outfit! (She carries Dennis with the shoes in the other hand.)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: "Ah, Perry the Platypus! How unexpected for you to burst in on my nefarious..." (Looks at a script) Nefarious? No, that's- That's too much, even for me.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus is due any second. (checking the time on his watch) Hey, it's getting a little late. Where is he?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, who needs him? He never even does anything until after I tell him my plans. He just stands there like a potted plant. (pauses, then notices a potted plant) In fact... (places a folded newspaper hat on the plant) Ah, Planty the Potted Plant. How unexpected! (pushes a button) I'd invite you to foil my latest scheme, (A rope comes down from a vent) but I can see you're all tied up. (Planty gets captured) You see, I don't even need Perry the Platypus!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Mom just got back from the grocery store, so we ought to have plenty of carrots for our x-ray glasses.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Thank you very much!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, actually, Candace, we need those.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, really? For your stupid x-ray glasses?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (angry, shows hand) Hey! They're not stu --

Name: Candace
Dialog: Do you know what this is?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Uh, is it not a rabbit?

Name: Candace
Dialog: This is an actual living creature that uses carrots for food instead of science experiments.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: So, why is he wearing a tutu?

Name: Candace
Dialog: He likes it! Don't worry, Mr. Cutie-Patootie. They're just jealous!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Come on, maybe Isabella has some carrots.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, let's start with the simple tricks. Sit.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Roll over!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Do the Worm.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Now the Robot.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Great! Wow, you must really like carrots! (Runs out of the living room)

Name: Linda
Dialog: What the? (Looks over to see Perry and Dennis in pet mode) Oh, a bunny rabbit. Candace must have gotten a new pet.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, Planty the Potted Plant, since you're just hanging around.... (chuckles) Let me demonstrate the brilliant evil-losity of my latest inven...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Grr. You see? See, that's what I'm talking about. Ever since those condos next door started allowing pets, it's been driving me bonkers! All day and all night with the barking, barking, barking! (pulls the lever) Oh, that is why I created my latest masterpiece of evil... giant Dog-Biscuit-inator!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Thank you! Thank you for my making my point for me! (to Planty) Now, I'll cover it with an irresistible gravy coating, (covers the biscuit in gravy) and then it will take off and soar through town, getting all the dogs to chase after it until they follow it right off the edge of the Tri-State area! (smiles smugly) Well, Planty the Potted Plant. Pretty clever, eh? (pauses, then pushes Planty away) Don't give me that look. Prepare to launch...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hey, how did you do that? (Gets hit on back of his head again) Ow! Ow! Alright Come out in the open where I can... Ow!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Stomp harder, Ferb! This carrot juice has gotta be really concentrated.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hey, Phineas. Whatcha doin'?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Just waiting for the concentrated carrot extract to mix with the super heated optical polymers. Now I dip the frames into the x-ray vision solution. (The frames successfully mix with the solution, creating orange swirls over green lenses) It might take a couple of hours to set properly.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Or just five minutes in my Quick-E-Bake Oven. Fireside Girls are always prepared. (She places the glasses in the oven)

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (Taps the x-ray glasses) Looks like they're ready. (Hands them to Phineas)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Here goes nothing!

Name: Vivian
Dialog: **OH NOOOOOOO!!!**

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hey, that sounds like it's coming from my house!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Mom, what's wrong?

Name: Vivian
Dialog: I lost my wedding ring!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Okay, Mom, what have you have been doing since you last saw it?

Name: Vivian
Dialog: Ah, si, si, si. I-I was fixing some lunch, then I washed the dishes heh.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (Raises an eyebrow) Dishes, huh? This looks like a job for x-ray vision glasses! (He puts on the glasses, then finds Vivian's wedding ring stuck in the drainpipe) I found it!

Name: Vivian
Dialog: Ah, thank you, Phineas. Uh...where is it?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Down in the drainpipe under the sink. (Moves left curtain) We'll have it out for you in a jiff. (to Ferb) Quick, Ferb! We need a 14-inch pipe wrench, a blowtorch, and a jar of mayonnaise.

Name: Vivian
Dialog: Ooh, that's very sweet of you boys, but I think I'll call my regular plumber. He's bonded.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (Takes off x-ray glasses) Okay, suit yourself.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: The glasses work great!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (Puts the glasses back on) This is gonna be fun!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Looks like our x-ray vision glasses have passed all the quality control tests.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Good thing, 'cause we're stacking up quite a pile of orders.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Excellent! It's time to order a big ol truck load of carrots.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mr. Cutie-Patootie?! Where are you?! MR. CUTIE PATOOTIE!!!

Name: Female Voice
Dialog: Intruder alert. Intruder alert.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Uh, hello, Agent- No! Not you! (While Dennis begins hacking the mainframe) Agent P, you have to stop him before he...

Name: Female Voice
Dialog: Access granted.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (While talking on the phone) Yes, ma'am, you heard me right. I need three metric tons of your highest grade carrots delivered A.S.A.P. (Person on the other end answers) Why yes, yes I am.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Have you seen Mr. Cutie-Patootie?! I can't find him anywhere!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, did you check the backyard? He might be there.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hmm. How about the kitchen?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Sighs wearily) Well, Planty the Potted Plant. You have proven yourself quite the adversary. Why don't we just...call this one a draw? (Plops himself against the door) I'm kind of pooped.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah! Curse you, Planty the Potted Plant!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Good work, Agent P. (Gives a thumbs up)

Name: Candace
Dialog: You don't suppose he could've run away?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Don't worry. I'm sure he'll turn up. (Notices that all the carrots have disappeared) Hey, what happened to all the carrots? One minute there's a backyard full of carrots. I turn around for half a minute and; Poof! – now they're gone!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Welcome to my world.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wow, that must be really annoying.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Notices Perry) Oh, there you are, Perry. (Perry tiredly lies on the stone walk; she then pets him) At least you're still around. Do you like wearing pink?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: On behalf of the entire Agency, I'd like to thank you for your valiant service in one of our darkest hours. (places a medal and a fedora on Planty) Planty the Potted Plant, welcome to the Agency.
